findings.finding: Higher-score endpoints show greater pair_kernel_2.5 (+0.631 z, CI 0.495–0.758, q=2.19e-5; all batches positive), with modest score correlation 0.213. Supplied 1.5/3.5 kernels are also positive, whereas 7.0 is negative; this supports a scale-specific association, not causal contact benefit.

shape_yy is lower in higher-score endpoints (-0.513 z, CI -0.620–-0.424, q=1.49e-5; no positive batches). Its increment contrast is also negative but weaker after correction (increment_effects:4, q=0.161). Lower y spread is a coordinate hypothesis with stronger endpoint than change evidence.

Landmark 00 soft_mass has immediate enrichment +0.639 z (q=0.000188), versus later survival +0.365 z across 14 batches (survival_effects:0, q=0.120; 12/14 positive). Endpoint occupancy3 is positive (q=0.000235), and softmin change is negative (increment_effects:14, q=0.0461). These align directionally, but corrected survival evidence is inconclusive and score credit is unavailable.

Landmark 07 local_cyy has immediate enrichment -0.646 z (q=7.08e-5; all batches negative), versus survival -0.299 z (survival_effects:75, q=0.219; 13/14 negative). Landmark 16 shows similar attenuation (-0.672 to -0.317 z). No sign reversal appears in these supplied comparisons, but later survival support is weaker.

Landmark 06 occupancy5 is negatively associated with endpoint score (-0.365 z, q=0.000679), although its last-minus-first delta is +0.603 z. Its softmin association is positive while its temporal delta is negative (endpoint_effects:32). Local_dy enrichment is positive (regional_effects:62, +0.425 z). Whole-window association and temporal movement are different observables; these summaries do not establish a stage-dependent rule.

Landmark 19 occupancy3 has near-zero endpoint association (-0.003 z, q=0.963) despite a large temporal delta (-1.372 z); landmark 11 occupancy3 is also unsupported (q=0.867). Temporal movement alone therefore does not identify a useful score-associated coordinate.

directions: Test modest contact_weight values from the allowed grid, checking whether the short-range kernel associations translate into higher final predicted pIC50 while monitoring strain and sub-2 Å clashes; retain repulsion_weight comparisons at 1, 2 and 4.

Treat landmark 00 mass and reduced y spread as exploratory coordinate hypotheses. Obtain empirical node contrasts, support counts and fitted-versus-observed checks before choosing time_ramp_power 0, 1 or 2.
Compare full, unweighted, static, structure and pocket programs under matched execution settings; evaluate final predicted pIC50, strain and graph transitions without preselecting a reward winner.

For structure-based hypotheses, vary ligand_anchor_weight within 0.5, 1 and 2 and native_rms_ratio within 0.1, 0.2 and 0.33. The original ligand geometry can suggest anchoring and shape tests, but supplies no affinity validation.
limitations: Only selected strongest eight and weakest two q-values per table are supplied; this is exploratory compressed evidence, not a complete enrichment analysis. Associations do not establish causal guidance effects.
Survival rows report 14 independent batches, but ancestral counts, diversity, descendant coverage and missingness are absent and cannot be quantified. Future score-credit contrasts are absent.
Empirical node contrasts, stage support and fitted-versus-observed results are absent; temporal deltas cannot establish local sign changes or justify a stage-dependent rule.

The supplied original structure has 25 ligand and 308 cropped protein heavy atoms, with ligand covariance eigenvalues 0.111, 5.696 and 9.303 Å²; it has no affinity labels. Geometry and the untyped pocket proxy cannot establish enrichment or physical affinity.

No intervention outcomes are supplied. Execution uses seed 42, 100 steps, window 0–0.5, endpoint VJP and native_rms_ratio 0.33, without particle selection or affinity-head gradient; transfer beyond this protocol is untested.
